fato_historico: 1030: The Battle of Azaz ends with a humiliating retreat of the Byzantine emperor, Romanos III Argyros, against the Mirdasid rulers of Aleppo. The retreat degenerates into a rout, in which Romanos himself barely escapes capture.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to reflect on shifting strategies. Much like historical tides that turn unexpectedly, you may find that retreating from a rigid path today allows for a stronger comeback tomorrow. It is a good time to reassess your current battles and consider if a flexible approach will better serve your long-term creative dreams.
frase_do_dia: True wisdom lies in knowing when to pivot and how to grow stronger.
significado_numero: Represents a fresh cycle of endings and new beginnings for you.
conselho: Prioritize your peace of mind over winning every small disagreement today.
